policy.stage: R1 A moves east and B west, exactly 4.5 inches
policy.screen: shallow south-east at 8:3, touch west footprint, longest eligible first
policy.follow: east, touch east footprint, longest eligible first
policy.respond: West aimed at west footprint (longest first); northwest diagonal aimed at east footprint (longest first); reserve one slot for each present route before testing additional eligible moves; take first native-accepted candidate, else issued Hold
policy.controls: A uses its issued Hold for each omitted action
policy.admission: identical restored prefix, ordered A2 Screen/Hold and Follow/Omit and B2 response, at least one native-accepted active response, exact common horizon and independent replay of each arm, no dependence on scoring values
